title: 第8章 太后的反击，皇后的决断
slug: 快活小御医恭喜皇后有喜了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

与此同时，慈宁宫内。

“砰！”

一只上好的汝窑茶盏，被狠狠摔在地上，四分五裂。

年仅四十的武太后，坐在凤榻之上，那张保养得宜的俏脸上，此刻阴云密布。

珠帘早已撤去，露出的那双丹凤眼，寒光闪烁。

“好一个以工代赈！”她咬着牙，一字一顿地从齿缝里挤出这几个字。

“哀家倒是小瞧了皇帝那个废物！”

刘烈是什么货色，她比谁都清楚。

一个从小被养废的藩王，脑子里除了吃喝玩乐，就是一团浆糊。

这种经天纬地的安国之策，打死他他也想不出来！

“皇帝背后一定有高人！”武太后猛地一拍扶手，冷声道。

“去查！给哀家把皇帝身边所有人，都查个底朝天！”

“尤其是最近新进宫，或者有过接触的人，一个都不要放过！”

就在这时，殿外传来一阵急促脚步声。

只见一个身影，连滚带爬地扑了进来，跪在地上嚎啕大哭。

“太后娘娘！您要为奴才做主啊！”

武太后皱眉看去，只见来人鼻青脸肿，半边脸肿得跟猪头一样，正是太医院的院判，赵德全。

“放肆！在太后娘娘面前哭哭啼啼，成何体统！”太后身边的老太监，厉声呵斥。

“赵院判，你这脸是怎么回事？”武太后秀眉微蹙。

赵德全一听，哭得更凶了。

他添油加醋，颠倒黑白地将昨晚发生的事情，哭诉了一遍。

在他嘴里，林墨成了一个仗着圣眷，嚣张跋扈，目无尊上的无耻小人。

“……娘娘啊，那林墨打了奴才的脸，还说……还说您是老……”

赵德全说到一半，故意佯装惊恐地捂住嘴，不敢再说下去。

“说什么？”武太后的声音听不出喜怒。

“说您是……老妖婆！”赵德全把心一横，喊了出来。

整个大殿瞬间死寂。

赵德全偷偷抬眼，看到武太后的脸色，肉眼可见的阴沉下来。

“林墨……”武太后凤眼微眯，嘴里喃喃自语。

“一夜之间，从七品太医，升为正六品院丞，还成了凤仪宫的专属太医？”

她将这两件事联系在一起，脑中豁然开朗。

原来是你！

那个在背后给皇帝出谋划策的高人，竟然是这个不知从哪冒出来的年轻太医！

好小子！

哀家倒要看看，你究竟是何方神圣，长了几个脑袋！

“来人！”武太后淡淡开口。

“传哀家懿旨，就说哀家最近心神不宁，让住在京郊药王山的孙百草老神医，即刻进宫，为哀家调理身体。”

“另外，告诉太医院，哀家凤体违和，让他们也派刚刚治愈皇后的林太医，过来瞧瞧。”

在武太后看来，一个毛头小子，就算有点小聪明，还能翻出天去？

哀家要对付你，甚至不用自己动手。

到时候，看看是你的歪门邪道厉害，还是孙百草的百年清誉更硬！

At the same time, inside Cining Palace.

"Bang!"

A fine Ru kiln tea cup was thrown to the ground and fell into pieces.

Empress Dowager Wu, who was only forty years old, was sitting on the phoenix couch. Her well-maintained and pretty face was now covered with clouds.

The bead curtain has long been removed, revealing the pair of red and phoenix eyes, shining with cold light.

"What a work-for-relief program!" She gritted her teeth and squeezed out these words one by one.

"The Ai family underestimated the emperor, that good-for-nothing!"

She knows better than anyone what kind of person Liu Lie is.

A vassal king who was raised useless since he was a child, except for eating, drinking and having fun, his mind is just a ball of mush.

Even if he were to be killed, he wouldn't be able to come up with this kind of strategy for reassuring the country, which is a long-standing strategy!

"There must be a master behind the emperor!" Empress Dowager Wu suddenly slapped the armrest and said coldly.

"Go and check! Check everyone around the emperor for the Ai family!"

"Especially those who have recently entered the palace or have had contact with them, don't let anyone go!"

At this moment, there was a rush of footsteps outside the hall.

Only a figure was seen, rolling in and crawling on the ground, kneeling on the ground and crying loudly.

"The Queen Mother! You have to make the decision for your servants!"

Empress Dowager Wu frowned and looked around, only to see the person coming with a bruised nose and a swollen face. Half of his face was as swollen as a pig's head. It was Zhao Dequan, the judge of the Taiyuan Hospital.

"Insolent! How unbecoming is it to cry in front of the Queen Mother!" The old eunuch beside the Queen Mother sternly scolded him.

"Magistrate Zhao, what's wrong with your face?" Empress Dowager Wu frowned slightly.

When Zhao Dequan heard this, he cried even harder.

He added fuel to the fire, confused black and white, and cried about what happened last night.

In his words, Lin Mo became a shameless villain who relied on the Holy Family, was arrogant and domineering, and had no respect for others.

"...Mother, Lin Mo slapped my slave in the face and said... He also said you are an old man..."

In the middle of speaking, Zhao Dequan deliberately pretended to be horrified and covered his mouth, not daring to say any more.

"What did you say?" Empress Dowager Wu's voice contained no emotion or anger.

"Say you are... an old witch!" Zhao Dequan shouted out with his heart pounding.

The entire hall fell silent for an instant.

Zhao Dequan secretly raised his eyes and saw Empress Dowager Wu's face becoming visibly gloomy.

"Lin Mo..." Empress Dowager Wu narrowed her eyes slightly and murmured to herself.

"Overnight, he was promoted from a seventh-grade imperial physician to a sixth-grade imperial minister, and also became the exclusive imperial physician of Fengyi Palace?"

She connected the two things, and her mind suddenly became enlightened.

It turns out to be you!

The expert who was advising the emperor behind the scenes turned out to be this young imperial doctor who appeared out of nowhere!

Good boy!

The Aijia would like to see who you are and how many heads you have grown!

"Come here!" Empress Dowager Wu said calmly.

"In passing on the Ai family's decree, they said that the Ai family has been uneasy recently, and asked Sun Baicao, the old miracle doctor who lives in Yaowang Mountain on the outskirts of Beijing, to come into the palace immediately to take care of the Ai family."

"Also, tell the Imperial Hospital that Ai Jia Feng's body is against the rules and ask them to also send Imperial Physician Lin, who just cured the empress, over to take a look."

In the opinion of Empress Dowager Wu, a young boy, even if he is a little smart, can he still make extraordinary achievements?

If the Ai family wants to deal with you, they don't even have to do it themselves.

When the time comes, let’s see which one is stronger, your crooked ways, or Sun Baicao’s century-old reputation!
